selection: demo windows: first/last 600 m of every leg
elevEncoding: int16 little-endian, centimetres above zMin (metres, areoid), 129 x 129, row 0 = north, shared edges (sample k at west + k/128 of the tile)
orthoEncoding: grayscale JPEG, 512 x 512, 0.25 m/px, row 0 = north
sandEncoding: 1-bit PNG, 256 x 256, 0.5 m/px, white = sand (derived from the ortho; ground truth only)
